dev: Push only registers on production builds. For local development set REACT_APP_ENABLE_PUSH_SYNC=true.
pwaDisabled: PWA disabled (REACT_APP_ENABLE_PWA=false in the frontend build).
unsupported: This browser cannot use push notifications (missing service worker or PushManager).
noVapid: The backend does not have VAPID configured (VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY / VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY on the server).
noSwTimeout: No active service worker in time (HTTPS / PWA build?). Reload or open as an installed PWA and try again.
errorSubscribe: Subscribe failed (network or server). Check the browser console for details.
fallback: Could not register for push notifications.
